rules.why: The class goes on the inline <svg>: only inline SVG inherits currentColor.
An icon is either decorative (aria-hidden="true" + focusable="false") or carries meaning (role="img" + aria-label) - never neither.
An icon that carries meaning names itself.

manual.why: Every .al-icon has aria-hidden="true" or role="img" - checked by the a11y.py, the engine has no "one of".
